purpose: Record official mainstream baseline code state and Phase07 compatibility gaps before any success claim.

clone_policy.reason: Preserve official code for compatibility audit while avoiding large checkpoint downloads before an approved faithful comparison run.

phase07_target_interface.current_embodiment: Newton Panda hydro scripted grasp/lift prior with residual adapter
phase07_target_interface.main_gap: Current Phase07 policy is a residual controller-parameter adapter, not a full VLA/diffusion action policy. Faithful mainstream comparison requires data/action conversion or an official incompatibility blocker.

official_code.name: OpenPI_pi0
official_interface_notes: Uses VLA checkpoints pretrained on 10k+ hours of robot data.
Fine-tuning requires converting data to LeRobot dataset format.
DROID/ALOHA examples expect named image observations, state, prompt, and action chunks.
Official README warns action dimension mismatches require data transforms/action-space definitions to match the robot.
official_code.required_next_step: Create a Phase07-to-LeRobot data/action mapping for Panda hydro or document why official OpenPI action/state transforms cannot faithfully control the residual-free Newton task.

official_code.name: Diffusion_Policy
official_interface_notes: ImagePolicy expects observation dictionaries and predicts action tensors of shape (B, Ta, Da).
Faithful new tasks require adding Dataset, EnvRunner, task config, shape_meta, and policy workspace configuration.
Published pretrained checkpoints are tied to benchmark tasks such as PushT and cannot directly operate the Newton Panda hydro task without a task/action adapter.
official_code.required_next_step: Build a Phase07 Diffusion Policy dataset/config/EnvRunner using official code, or document a concrete mismatch preventing faithful evaluation.

official_code.name: Open_X_RT_X
official_interface_notes: RT-1-X input is RGB workspace camera plus task string.
RT-1-X does not use wrist camera, in-hand camera, or depth in the documented checkpoint path.
Action dimensions are gripper-frame x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, and gripper opening represented as absolute, delta, or velocity variables.
JAX inference example requires a downloaded RT-1-X checkpoint.
official_code.required_next_step: Download official RT-1-X checkpoint only for a faithful audit run, then test whether 7D gripper-frame actions can be mapped to Newton Panda hydro waypoints without silently changing the task.

official_code.name: NVIDIA_Isaac_GR00T
official_interface_notes: GR00T uses GR00T-flavored LeRobot v2 data with meta/modality.json.
Every inference or fine-tuning command requires an embodiment tag.
N1.7 uses relative EEF action space for cross-embodiment generalization.
Official README says base model download is about 6 GB on first run and fine-tuning recommends 40 GB+ VRAM.
official_code.required_next_step: Create a NEW_EMBODIMENT modality config and Phase07 LeRobot dataset conversion plan, or document why GR00T cannot faithfully close the Newton Panda hydro cup task.

completion_impact.reason: Official code is now available locally, but no official checkpoint comparison, faithful adapter run, or concrete incompatibility blocker has been completed.
